thread:
sam: Quick design ask — need a compact deliverable for the March 31 webinar and the post-event inbound flow. Goal: one hero benchmark graphic, a 2-slide funnel diagram for inbound routing, and 3 social card variants with accessible color options. Can design take this?

maya: Yep, can do. Need clarity on hero dimensions and whether the benchmark should show latency vs cost or p50/p95 only.

omar: for the webinar we want latency vs cost scatter + a simplified p50/p95 callout. Marketing will provide the benchmark numbers by EOD tomorrow.

maya: Got it. So hero = scatter with two annotated callouts (p50, p95). Funnel = 2-slide sequence: 1) registration -> qualification -> trial; 2) post-webinar routing (nurture vs SDR). Social = 3 sizes: IG 1080x1080, LinkedIn 1200x627, X 800x450.

rachel: Brand compliance notes: use approved type scale and brand palette. Also need an alt-text line and a compact footer lockup that says "Redwood Inference — production-ready inference". Avoid using the purple gradient background for the scatter; use high-contrast neutral background for accessibility.

alex: For localization: APAC variant needs simplified copy and a second color palette option (dark mode friendly). Also request an animated micro-sparkline for the social cards (10-15 frame GIF).

maya: Timeline check — we can draft static comps by tomorrow noon PT, animated cards by Friday. Need the benchmark CSV and any copy variants today.

omar: attaching raw metrics now: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-webinar-inbound.csv — includes columns: model, tokens/sec, cost_per_1000, p50_ms, p95_ms. For copy, use these CTAs: "Try a demo", "Join the trial", "Watch on demand".

maya: Thanks. Quick question on legal: do we need a claims check for the scatter annotations? rachel, do we need legal review?

rachel: Legal review only if we state specific dollar savings or SLA guarantees. Keep annotations descriptive ("lower cost", "lower latency") and include source note in footer: "internal benchmark; illustrative". We'll do a quick brand/legal sweep after comps.

maya: Perfect. Design notes -> creating a Figma file under /Marketing/2026/webinar-inbound-bench. Naming convention for assets: MIQ_bench2026_channel_variant (example: MIQ_bench2026_linkedin_static). Will paste Figma link when ready.

alex: For the animated sparkline, can you keep file size under 2MB for social? Also provide an MP4 fallback for LinkedIn.

maya: Yep, will optimize GIF and provide MP4. Also will export SVGs for the funnel diagram and a PNG variant for email.

sam: Thanks team. Two follow-ups: 1) can we add a one-column copy-first thumbnail for the webinar landing page? 2) can design include a small modular component (badge) that the SDR/CX team can drop into emails showing "Webinar: Inference Economics — 30 min"

maya: Yes to both. Badge options: round and pill. Will include 3 size options and color variants.

design-bot: Reminder — please tag final assets with the release tag format: release/bench-inbound/2026-03-31. Automated export will pick up files tagged in Figma.

rachel: I'll coordinate brand/legal sweep once comps are in. Omar, please confirm final metrics by 3pm PT. Sam — will you own landing thumbnail copy?

omar: final metrics confirmed at 14:15 PT.

sam: I got landing copy draft, will post in thread in 30m. Thanks all :rocket:
